title: AR15: Mud Test
summary: InRangeTV subjects an AR-15 to a mud test in the same mud and location as a preceding AK-47 test. It shows how the rifle runs when covered in mud.
why: Cited in AR versus AK reliability debates as evidence that the AR-15 handles mud better than its reputation suggests.

quote.text: the purported advantages of AK action over its competitors in this regard are rather drastically overstated in popular culture
